intro: Our Superlatx mattress blends firm support with latex-powered comfort—cool, breathable, and built to help you sleep deeper, longer, and healthier every night.

features.title: Natural latex comfort layer
features.text: The top layer gently adapts to your body, offering bounce, breathability, and pressure relief the natural way.

features.title: Hypoallergenic and dust-resistant
features.text: Safe for sensitive sleepers, it resists dust and allergens for a cleaner, healthier sleep every night.

features.title: Firm yet cushioned feel
features.text: Enjoy a perfect balance—firm support beneath a gently cushioned surface that keeps your body aligned and relaxed.

features.title: Breathable and moisture-wicking fabric
features.text: Soft and airy fabric pulls away moisture and heat, helping you stay cool and dry throughout the night.

features.title: Long-lasting durability
features.text: Built to endure years of nightly use, this mattress holds its shape and support without sagging.

features.title: Sleep as it suits you
features.text: Whether you sleep on your back, side, or stomach, Superlatx offers reliable support and comfort.

name: Superlatx Single Bed Latex Mattress 72 X 35 X 6 Inches
